payload.note: Claims are sentence-level. A compound sentence asserting two facts is verified as one claim against its strongest evidence, so a sentence that is half-supported can pass. Sub-sentence decomposition (FActScore-style) needs a generative pass and was rejected on token budget and on the risk of inventing claims the draft never made.

payload.text: These insights inform the design of evaluation protocols that isolate the contribution of each component .
The abstract of the repLLaMA‑rankLLaMA study notes that the decoder is the primary component for successful retrieval, but it does not quantify the computational overhead or memory footprint required
The study does not explore whether incorporating external knowledge bases or structured reasoning modules could bridge this gap .
The lack of quantitative benchmarks for multimodal hallucination detection remains a critical limitation .
The scalability of this governance framework to larger, more heterogeneous knowledge graphs is yet to be demonstrated .
